mechanism: Betamethasone promotes sodium retention and potassium excretion while spironolactone promotes potassium retention and sodium excretion, creating opposing pharmacodynamic effects with significant electrolyte imbalance risk.
action: Monitor serum potassium and sodium levels closely; adjust spironolactone dose or consider alternative corticosteroid if potassium depletion occurs; patient education on dietary potassium intake is essential.
